title: incident-bot: integrate slo-toolkit runbook linking and on-call diagnostics helpers
author: Priya Desai
description:
Background: On-call engineers frequently need quick, context-rich links to runbooks and SLO diagnostics during incidents. This PR integrates runbook linking from the slo-toolkit into incident-bot and adds a set of on-call diagnostics helper utilities that surface prioritized SLO context, recent rollout links, and suggested next steps. Motivation: reduce MTTI/MTTR by making runbook discovery and SLO diagnostics immediate in the on-call workflow and automate common triage steps. What this change does: 1) Adds a new runbook linking API adapter in incident-bot that queries the slo-toolkit runbook index and attaches prioritized links to incident notifications. 2) Introduces on-call diagnostics helpers (slo_snapshot, recent_rollouts, service_health_summary) that run as part of the autodiagnostics pipeline. 3) Adds a lightweight cache and TTL to prevent excessive lookups during alert storms. 4) Exposes a feature flag (runbook_linking.enabled) and a canary scoped to internal on-call teams. Backwards compatibility: default feature flag is off; runbook schema compatibility maintained. Testing: unit tests for adapter and helpers added; integration test that simulates an SLO breach and asserts runbook links appear in the incident payload. Performance: cache reduces downstream calls; added metrics for runbook_lookup_latency and lookup_hit_rate. Checklist:
- [x] Adapter implementation
- [x] Diagnostics helpers
- [x] Unit + integration tests
- [x] Feature flag + canary
- [x] Docs + runbook templates updated
Deployment plan: merged to main with feature flag off, enable canary for internal on-call team for 72h, monitor runbook_lookup_latency and oncall_feedback. Rollback: toggle feature flag off and revert cache TTL if needed. Merge method: squash and merge. See commits and file changes below for details.
commits: feat(runbook): add slo-toolkit runbook adapter and lookup service
feat(autodiag): add on-call diagnostics helpers (slo_snapshot, recent_rollouts)
test(autodiag): integration test for runbook linking in incident flow
chore(config): add feature flag and canary config, update docs
review_comments: Noah Kim: Can we make the cache TTL configurable per-service? In some noisy services a short TTL might still be too chatty.
Priya Desai (author): Good point — made TTL configurable via feature flag overrides and added tests to ensure overrides are respected.
Samir Patel: LGTM overall. Left one comment about error handling in adapter.go (fallthrough vs. bubble up).
Priya Desai (author): Updated adapter to bubble non-404 errors and added clearer logs; added unit test for adapter error paths.
Maya Chen: Can we add a small e2e to validate links render correctly in Slack/Email payloads?
Priya Desai (author): Added an integration test that validates the payload contains prioritized runbook links for Slack; email rendering is handled by the notification layer unchanged.
Noah Kim: CI flakes on python lint check, rerun tests after fix.
release_notes:
- incident-bot: add runbook linking via slo-toolkit
- incident-bot: add on-call diagnostics helpers (slo_snapshot, recent_rollouts, service_health_summary)
- Feature flagged and rolled out as canary to internal on-call teams
- Adds metrics: runbook_lookup_latency, runbook_lookup_hit_rate
Notes: feature is opt-in; no breaking changes expected.
